name: omp-dev-team
description: Oh-My-Pi marketplace of six independent plugins: dev-team, copilot-preset, token-diet, azure-devops-fs, cliproxy, and datadog.
comment: This repo is an OMP MARKETPLACE. Catalog: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; plugins live under plugins/<name>/, each with its own package.json (omp.extensions) and .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Add it with `omp plugin marketplace add <repo-or-./>` then install plugins individually. All six plugins are independent and share nothing.
